annotations.title: Get Structured Monster and Quest Facts

description:
Read RS3 monster combat stats or quest metadata. Use search_wiki for titles, get_wiki_page_content for reviewed text/links, or get_item_details for GE records.

Pass page as a literal title with spaces; the server URL-encodes it. Only main articles qualify. URLs, #variants, |separators and Category: titles are rejected. kind=quest includes miniquests, subquests and sagas; a mismatched dataset errors.

limit expands a prefix, not a page: raising 5 to 10 repeats the first five variants before adding more. Choose variants by their returned references. Truncation requires a larger limit or visiting the returned source link; there is no cursor.

Missing fields are omitted, not zero-filled. Article prose/images are excluded. The uncached index may lag. No credentials required; HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute. Honor 429 Retry-After.

kind.description: Structured dataset: combat monster statistics or quest metadata

limit.description: Maximum variant records from the selected page (default 5)

page.description: Wiki page title, e.g. Abyssal demon or Cook's Assistant; redirects are resolved

name: get_wiki_entity_facts

license.description: No article-content license or review is inferred for these index facts

ids.description: Wiki-indexed entity IDs, not GE item IDs

reference.description: Indexed page/variant identifier, not article text

truncated.description: Additional indexed variants exceeded the requested limit
